msi2026.policy: exact locked MSI branch of v312

interpretation: WPS is the observed change in frozen modeled win probability around a commentary-selected play, not a causal contribution estimate.

game_flow.source_curve: one-second application curve, observed broadcast seconds only
game_flow.role: post hoc description of a finished game; not a model input
game_flow.smoothing: winner_min_p, decided_gc and lead_changes use the median of observed seconds within +/-2s
game_flow.winner_min_p: lowest smoothed win probability of the eventual winner
game_flow.decided_gc: first observed game-clock second after the winner's last smoothed probability below 0.5; null when the winner never trailed
game_flow.swing_total_pp: sum of absolute changes between consecutive 30-second game-clock bin medians, in percentage points
game_flow.winner_max_gold_deficit: largest broadcast gold deficit of the eventual winner; 0 when the winner never trailed in gold

top_moments.frame: acting team named by the commentary; a negative value favours the opponent
top_moments.ranking: largest absolute observed win-probability swing among valid plays
top_moments.deduplication: within one game a play is dropped when a larger listed play shares its episode or starts within the window length of it
top_moments.phase: the play's coded game phase; 'all' ranks every phase together
top_moments.interpretation: Observed modeled state change; not a causal action effect.
